simple.meaning: הִלּוּל (hillûwl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Leviticus, Judges, beginning at Leviticus 19:24. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הִלּוּל (H1974).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: הִלּוּל (hillûwl) / H1974 is traced through Leviticus 19:24, Judges 9:27 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest
definitions.full: H1974. hillul [ הִלּוּל ] noun [masculine] (Late Hebrew id. ) only plural הִלּוּלִים rejoicing, praise : 1 הִלּוּלִים וִיַּעֲשׂוּ Judg 9:27 i.e. a vintage-rejoicing, merry-making, connected with thanksgiving אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בֵּית וַיָּבאֹוּ etc. (i.e. god baal-Berith, see 9:4 ). 2 of praise to ה ׳פקדֶשׁ ׳י, Lev 19:24 (H) holiness of praise , i.e. a consecrated thing in token of thanksgiving for fruit, offered in 4th year (compare Late Hebrew).
